_what: game-two-audio -> game-two-assets audio handoff, batch v1.1 (M5, 2026-08-19). Owner-performed in-house renders (Reaper 7.79 + owner VSTs; agent-scaffolded MIDI gestures per game-two drafts/_audio-cue-spec-attacks-20260819.md), delivered via Downloads/msfx_v11 and ingested game-side same day (commits f228df8: 23 attack/effect takes; 3d20b93: 3 ambient-v2 drone variants). NO third-party audio, NO sample-pack content. These are the production source masters; the game runtime uses the 24->16 conversions pinned in game-two data/audio/fixtures.json (each replicated and sha-verified at banking time, see per-asset game_ingest). Take rotation is GAME-SIDE (data/audio/variants.json + VariantRotor; synthetic events attack_hit__a...) — this library and the game-two-audio schema are unchanged. Consumer: the game-two-assets exports pipeline (its manifest/provenance/loudness law governs runtime files; LUFS is deliberately unmeasured here — the assets pipeline measures at ingest per music-production/game-audio-pipeline.md).
